$comment: The schema of the trimmed extension manifest VS Code expects of a cats extension, checked on every rendered package.json before packing.
title: A cats extension's package.json
description: The trimmed extension manifest VS Code expects of a cats extension, the fields New-VsCodeExtensionFolder renders from vscode-extensions.yml. Build-VsCodeExtension validates every rendered package.json against this schema before packing and fails the build on a mismatch; the rendered manifests live under out/ and are reached only by address, so package.sample.json beside it is what Test-Contracts checks it against. contributes is VS Code's vocabulary and is held open.

catzc.description: What the installed shell needs from the repository: source is the extension's folder, repository-relative, resolved from its name through the js track, so the shell spells no folder of its own.
